description: This file implements a PDU (Protocol Data Unit) parser for SMS messages, including decoding, creating PDUs, generating status reports, and handling phone number conversions, primarily used in a modem simulator context.

classes.name: PDUParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, creating, and handling SMS PDU messages, including decoding raw PDU strings, generating status reports, and manipulating phone number data.

methods.name: DecodePDU
methods.description: Decodes a raw PDU string to extract message details such as address, protocol, data coding scheme, and user data.

methods.name: CreatePDU
methods.description: Constructs a PDU string from parsed message components, including timestamp and user data.

methods.name: IsNeededStatuReport
methods.description: Determines if a status report is needed based on the PDU type.

methods.name: CreateStatuReport
methods.description: Generates a status report PDU for a given message reference.

methods.name: CreateRemotePDU
methods.description: Creates a remote PDU by modifying the phone number with a specified host port.

methods.name: GetPhoneNumberFromAddress
methods.description: Extracts the phone number from the originator address field.

methods.name: HexCharToInt
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its integer value.

methods.name: Hex2ToByte
methods.description: Converts a two-character hexadecimal string to its byte value.

methods.name: IntToHexString
methods.description: Converts an integer to a two-digit hexadecimal string.

methods.name: IntToHexStringTimeZoneDiff
methods.description: Converts timezone difference in hours to a GSM 03.40 format string.

methods.name: BCDToString
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded string to its ASCII representation.

methods.name: StringToBCD
methods.description: Converts an ASCII string to its BCD-encoded representation.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in GSM format based on current local time.
